input.selection: optional exact case name; omitted means all default cases

variable_constraints.$pid: integer in [1,2147483647], same process for all records and same pid in credential case pass
variable_constraints.$uid: integer in [0,4294967295], C compares actual received credential with own getuid
variable_constraints.$gid: integer in [0,4294967295], C compares actual received credential with own getgid
variable_constraints.$first_payload_read: integer in [1,96]; C validates every returned byte, rejects overlength, total must be96

fields.cases: 8 for all; 1 for a named case

fields.cases_passed: number of previous case_pass records;0 for single case
fields.failed_case: current case or input on setup failure

scheduled_stale_snapshot.requires_kernel_window_marker: bound by runner to same boot: stale length0, new length96, shutdown true; no arbitrary timeout/panic accepted

abort_exit_codes.124: alarm guard; never a semantic success
abort_exit_codes.125: stdout formatting/writing failure; never a semantic success

external_harness: Shell records independent actual exit code with same nonce and continues native boot exit. Neither QEMU33 nor case_pass alone is success.
